europe_now.title: European powers coordinate representation for Ukraine peace negotiations
europe_now.summary: European leaders have agreed that France, Germany, the UK, Italy, Poland, and Brussels will jointly represent European interests in upcoming Ukraine peace talks, bypassing the appointment of a single envoy. This collective diplomatic approach comes as the continent grapples with the wider strategic and security implications of the ongoing conflict.

sources.headline: France among five major powers to represent EU in Ukraine talks

europe_now.title: France commemorates the eleventh anniversary of the November 13 Paris attacks
europe_now.summary: France observed solemn tributes across the nation to honor the victims of the deadly November 13 terror attacks carried out eleven years ago. The annual commemorations serve as a national reflection on the enduring impact of the tragedy on public security and society.

sources.headline: November 13 Paris attacks: Eleven years later, France pays tribute to victims

top_stories.title: European Union diplomatic strategy in Ukraine negotiations
top_stories.summary: European Union leaders have designated a group of major powers alongside Brussels to handle upcoming diplomatic talks regarding Ukraine. This multi-nation representation replaces the concept of a singular envoy to manage regional peace negotiations.

top_stories.title: Resumption of United States air traffic following nationwide shutdown
top_stories.summary: Air traffic across the United States has officially resumed after a nearly five-hour nationwide ground stop caused by communication issues. The Federal Aviation Administration lifted the restrictions once the technical problems were resolved.
